newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian 88 shr issue, private placement.
newsitem.headline: Canadian 88 shr issue, private placement.

text.p: Canadian 88 Energy Corp said on Thursday it agreed to issue eight million shares at C$5.20 a share for gross proceeds of C$41.6 million and also entered a private placement for the issue of one million flow-through shares at C$5.50 each for gross proceeds of C$5.5 million.
Canadian 88 said the underwriters for the C$41.6 million share issue had an option for an additional one million shares at C$5.20 a share.

It said the issue would let it expand and accelerate its 1996-97 capital spending budget. Priorites include expansion of the Olds/Crossfield gas plant and processing capacity, additional wells at Olds/Crossfield, additional wells at Waterton, an aggressive land acquisition program and pursuit of additional asset acquisitions in core areas of west central Alberta.
